Failed speech-worker restart crashes the HTTP server

Clearing the Activity date crashes the UI
Failed interruption leaves microphone resources open with no Stop handle
Meals hides additional unplanned meals in the same slot
Voice becomes enabled before startup priming frees the synthesizer
All tunneled users share the login rate-limit bucket
